|lore=The Jedi won't tolerate silly behavior for very long.
|game_text=Plays on table. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Mobilization Points is suspended. “Missing” on Always Thinking With Your Stomach is treated as “landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.”
|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V)]] (version 2 of 6). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. The current text is [[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 10, slip “•Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Mobilization Points is suspended. “Missing” on Always Thinking With Your Stomach is treated as “landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.”” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•Don’t Do That Again”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 8 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/dontdothatagaintatooine.gif dontdothatagaintatooine.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. While opponent occupies no battleground systems, Mobilization Points is suspended. “Missing” on Always Thinking With Your Stomach is treated as “landspeed = 0 for remainder of turn.”” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•Don’t Do That Again (V)”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 27 August 2021<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/649630f/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/dontdothatagaintatooine.gif dontdothatagaintatooine.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/649630f 649630f] (27 August 2021, “200: Added *E* where missing and updated some game text”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Always Thinking With Your Stomach, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl are canceled. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.” Printed: marked “E”; lower-left name “•Don’t Do That Again (V)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E” but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata (image marked “E”): Always Thinking With Your Stomach, Ice Storm and Sandwhirl are now canceled outright; the “Missing” sentence is removed; “While opponent occupies no battleground systems” becomes “Unless opponent occupies a battleground system”. The set icon at the lower right changes from the diamond-shaped D to the round Virtual Set D icon. The commit that added it is titled “200: Added *E* where missing and updated some game text”; the [[Don't Do That Again (Reflections III) (V)|Reflections III-base printing]] had shown this text since 12 July 2020.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/dontdothatagaintatooine.gif dontdothatagaintatooine.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/dontdothatagaintatooine.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Always Thinking With Your Stomach, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl are canceled. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “Don’t Do That Again (Tatooine)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words (new line breaks). The lower-left name now reads “Don’t Do That Again (Tatooine)” and the errata mark is printed as “E1”.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 4)]]): Card image published 22 July 2024<ref name="v4-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6c22b09/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Light/large/dontdothatagaintatooine.gif dontdothatagaintatooine.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6c22b09 6c22b09] (22 July 2024, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Light/hires/dontdothatagaintatooine.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a546b30 a546b30] (21 July 2024, “Set 23 Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.” Printed: marked “E2”; lower-left name “Don’t Do That Again (Tatooine)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E2” but is errata 4 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata released with [[Virtual Set 23]] and the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref> (image marked “E2”): “Always Thinking With Your Stomach, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl are canceled.” becomes “Cancels Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl.” (He Hasn't Come Back Yet added; moved to the start of the text).
* '''PC-E5''' ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 5)]]): Partial slip in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 2: partial slip labelled “•Don’t Do That Again (Tatooine)”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, Ice Storm, and Sandwhirl. Once per game, may ▲ an Immediate Effect. Unless opponent occupies a battleground system, Mobilization Points is suspended.” '''Errata mark:''' this slip prints “E2” but is errata 5 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the 22 July 2024 card image ([[Don't Do That Again (Tatooine) (V) (Errata 3)]]). The kit prints the card as a partial slip — the title bar and lore, a blank white area where the picture is, and the game-text box — with the lower-left name and the errata mark “E2” at the bottom, to be laid over a printed card. A separate PC publication that looks visibly different from the card image, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication and every visible change is a version).
